project.title: flutter_report_suite
project.tagline: A reusable Flutter report and PDF generation suite with template-driven rendering.

summary.short: flutter_report_suite provides reusable report_engine components for template-driven PDF rendering, report values, paper configuration, printing, and storage.
summary.long: The repository includes reusable report_engine architecture with ReportTemplate, PaperConfig, ReportElement, ReportValueResolver, PdfRenderService, FlutterReportPrinter, template storage, JSON templates, and Thai font support.
